0b5db31c-78f7-4194-814c-824348b60836.quote: The better plan for the last stretch was to stop gambling the lead on even fights. With every Fangtooth and a structure lead already in hand, one inner tower was cheap and the base was not. The alternative was to concede that tower and fight under the next one with all five together, Aurora and Kwang holding their crowd control for Serath's dive and GRIM.exe behind them. It would not guarantee the win, but it makes them beat our full team on our terms instead of a coin flip.
0b5db31c-78f7-4194-814c-824348b60836.issue: calls the late fights even when the source shows Kwang died shortly before both and one of ours was dead at the first; the reflection omits the regroup it actually recommends
0b5db31c-78f7-4194-814c-824348b60836.rewrite: The better late plan was to stop fighting before everyone was back. Kwang died shortly before both late fights we lost, and one of ours was still dead when the first began. With every Fangtooth and a structure lead in hand, one inner tower was cheap and the base was not. The alternative was to concede that tower, wait for all five, and fight under the next one, Aurora and Kwang holding crowd control for Serath's dive and GRIM.exe behind them. It would not guarantee the win.

0b5db31c-78f7-4194-814c-824348b60836.quote: For most of this game we were the team taking the map. All three Fangtooths and the first Genesis Core went our way, we outkilled them 27 to 23, and we led four structures to three going into the last fight. Nobody solved Serath: no deaths all game, and four of our five deaths in the late fight we lost 1-5. Then we lost a fight 0-5, and both inner towers, an inhibitor and our Core fell during and right after it, with the Genesis Core going to them.

0b5db31c-78f7-4194-814c-824348b60836.quote: Cuban Noobster's Aurora was the strongest game on our side. All three Fangtooths came our way, Aurora led the lobby in objective damage, farm and damage ran well over the usual Aurora pace, and Belica died to Aurora five times. Serath was the exception: never killed, and Aurora died to Serath twice. Next game, against a snowballing jungler, Aurora holds Cryoseism for that jungler's dive and freezes Serath on the landing, giving Hoarfrost a target that cannot walk away.

0b5db31c-78f7-4194-814c-824348b60836.quote: On the common winning core. Lightning Hawk builds Momentum while moving or attacking for an empowered, slowing hit; Plasma Blade stacks critical chance and Dust Devil stacks attack speed while hitting heroes, with movement speed at full stacks. Tainted Rounds cuts healing on basic attacks and adds on-hit damage that grows as the target's health falls, a real fit against Serath and Valmont's healing. Nuclear Rounds raises ability damage with critical chance, which feeds Displacement Blast and GTFO. Final inventory does not show purchase timing.
